Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Davao de Oro's 2nd congressional district''' is a [[congressional districts of the Philippines|congressional district]] for the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Davao de Oro]], formerly '''Compostela Valley'''.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 24, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} It was created ahead of the [[1998 Philippine House of Representatives elections]] by Republic Act No. 8470 that established the province initially named Compostela Valley.{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=8740|date=January 30, 1998|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/1998/01/30/republic-act-no-8470/|title=An Act Creating the Province of Compostela, Valley From the Province of Davao Del Norte, and for Other Purposes|publisher=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]]|accessdate=February 24, 2021|archive-date=December 1, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171201041924/http://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/1998/01/30/republic-act-no-8470/|url-status=dead}} The district encompasses two noncontiguous areas of Davao de Oro: [[Laak, Davao de Oro|Laak]] in the Davao–Agusan Trough and the valley and coastal municipalities adjoining the provincial capital of [[Nabunturan]], namely [[Mabini, Davao de Oro|Mabini]], [[Maco, Davao de Oro|Maco]], [[Mawab]] and [[Pantukan]]. Much of these areas were previously within [[Davao del Norte's 2nd congressional district|Davao del Norte's 2nd district]]. [[Jhong Ceniza]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]], currently serves as this district's representative in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]], the first under the province's new name of Davao de Oro.{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=11297|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/2019/04/17/republic-act-no-11296-2/ |title=An Act Renaming the Province of Compostela Valley as the Province of Davao De Oro |date=April 17, 2019 |publisher=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]] |accessdate=February 24, 2021}}{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 24, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
